description:
Module inside lernie-ui-dioxus that watches paths under a conversation repo and emits changes to a receiver. Per ARCH §3.1 / §3.5.

=== What to build ===

- Pure-Rust module, no Dioxus dependency (this is testable in isolation).
- API: 'Watcher::new(repo_root: &Path) -> Result<Watcher, Error>' + an async/iter surface that yields change events.
- Underlying impl: use the 'notify' crate for inotify + polling fallback (notify provides both with a uniform API).
- Watched paths follow §3.5: the git tree (repo_root), '.agent/state/branches.json', '.agent/goal.md' (per branch, so under each worktree), 'exchanges/**', 'invocations/**', 'artifacts/**', 'tools/**', '.agent/compactions/**'.
- Change coalescing: rapid sequential writes (e.g., inotify emits multiple events per atomic-rename) are coalesced to one event per file per tick.
- No state mutation on the repo. Strict read-only observation.

=== Out of scope ===

- Any rendering logic. The module hands events to downstream consumers.
- The view-model transformation (that's for the git-tree renderer task).
- Watching files outside the repo.

=== Dependencies ===

- Blocks on 'UI skeleton' — needs the lernie-ui-dioxus crate to exist first.

=== Testing ===

- Unit tests against a tmpfs-backed tempdir: create a fixture repo layout, mutate files, assert events fire with expected paths + kinds.
- Coalescing test: atomic-rename (temp + rename) emits one coalesced event, not two.
- No live filesystem events outside the tempdir (tests must be isolated and parallel-safe).
- 100% line coverage.
title: UI: filesystem watcher module (inotify + polling fallback)
